items.caption: This module integrates the weather warnings and radar images provided by the German Weather Service (DWD) into Symcon.
NOTE: Each new selection resets the following variables to default values!
... the following styles can be set for the display of HTML elements:

Specifier: %L = Warning level (text), %N = Warning level (number),
%T = Warning Type, %M = Message, %D = Description
... to send notification messages to a visualization:
... to use the dashboard message script. More information you get in the forum to thema: Meldungsanzeige im WebFront:
With a key, each warning gets its own message (key.ID), which is updated instead of added again and removed automatically when the warning ends (requires message script v8 or newer).

The buttons are placed in the corners of the map. If both are in the same corner, they are shown side by side. Map area and view (medium tile size) are changed directly in the tile and remembered per device.
